summary_ja: 人的判断又はモデルに基づく内部格付制度において、格付及び推計値の変更に関する規定、監視手続、責任者の特定及び変更後の実績の記録を定める。
summary_en: Requires clear rules on changes to ratings and estimates under judgment-based systems, monitoring of overrides under model-based systems, identification of responsible persons, and recording of post-change performance.
paragraphs: Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach operates an internal rating system based on human judgment, it shall establish clear provisions concerning the following matters and other matters relating to changes to ratings and estimates: (i) The method of change; (ii) The range within which changes may be made; (iii) The person responsible for changes.

Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach operates a model-based internal rating system, it shall establish procedures and guidelines for monitoring the following matters: (i) Changes by human judgment to model-based rating assignments or estimation results; (ii) Exclusion of variables used in the model; (iii) Changes to model inputs.
The guidelines referred to in the preceding paragraph shall identify the person responsible for changes to rating assignments or estimation results.
Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach has made changes to ratings and estimates, it shall record the post-change performance for each change.
